# Pathora

> Pathora is a career-readiness platform for students, recent graduates, NYSC members and entry-level job seekers, starting with Nigeria. It helps people understand job descriptions, turn real experience into evidence, build and tailor a CV, practise interviews in text, and track applications.

Pathora never invents experience, gives match scores or predicts hiring outcomes. Application statuses are updated by the user, not fetched from employers.

## Tools
- [Job Description Analyser](/tools/job-analyser)
- [Experience-to-Evidence Builder](/tools/evidence-builder)
- [CV Studio](/tools/cv-builder)
- [Interview Practice](/tools/interview-practice)
- [Application Tracker](/tools/application-tracker)
